title: 第19章 驱邪符第20章 贺磊的请求
content_zh:
“光芒？什么光芒？”
中年男子微微一愣，低头一看，这才发现他左边裤包里的确散发出微弱的光芒。他伸手一掏，一张符篆出现在了手中。
此刻，符篆上那复杂的纹路自动散发出光芒，光芒流转，如梦如幻。
中年男子将符篆翻过来，“驱邪符”三个字顿时引入眼帘！
“这……这不是……”
中年男子目瞪口呆，这不是戴墨镜小伙子贩卖的符篆吗？怎么在他兜里，难道是那小子趁他不注意塞进来的，而且这光芒怎么回事？
难道……自己家里真的有邪气？
中年越想越惊愕，随后他手持符篆在家里走来走去，随着他的走动，符篆的光芒时而强烈时而微弱，最强烈的地方，就是他摆放青铜剑的地方。
当他将整个房间转了一遍的时候，符篆的光芒彻底消息。
“阿豪，这是怎么回事？怎么我忽然感觉四周的空气要变得清晰不少，脑袋也不那么沉重了。”
中年男子看着手中的驱邪符，喃喃道：“阿英，不知道为何，我有种感觉，我周家或许要转运了。”
“真的吗？”
男子还想说些什么，电话忽然想起来了，是他的助理。
“什么事情？”
“周总，好消息，我们集团的股票绝地反弹了。另外，京都王家的秘书打来电话，打算入股我们豪天集团，股市的动静应该就是他们弄出来的。”
“什么？你说什么！”
“我说京都王家入股我们集团，明日让你去一趟京都。”
“哈哈哈哈，好！好！”
中年男子笑了，这是这两个月来，他第一次哈哈大笑。
……

张逸风回到宿舍，舒服的睡了一觉，一大早，他就起床出去练拳了。在修为无法提升的情况下，**力量的提升也尤为重要。万一地球真不适合修炼，他也能成为体修者，一体破万道。
练了两个小时，张逸风又去跑步了，他是在练习神风步法。
时间流逝，张逸风正打算去吃午饭，一个陌生电话打了进来。
“谁？”张逸风冷漠地开口。
贺娅娇的声音从电话里传来：“是我，贺娅娇。我爸妈回去了，今天晚上我打算请章笑天他们吃饭，再问你一次，你去不去？”
“没兴趣。”
张逸风简单说了三个字便挂了电话，丝毫不给新晋校花一点面子。
“张逸风，你混蛋！”
电话那头，贺娅娇气得张牙舞爪，要不是她将张逸风当成朋友，她才不会叫张逸风呢，真是不识好人心！
张逸风刚刚挂了电话，电话又响了，低头一看，居然是赵龙打的。
“赵龙，什么事？”
赵龙略微疲惫的声音传来：“我想问问你关于拳法的问题。还有，贺娅娇有没有请你去吃饭？”
“怎么，她也叫你去吃饭了吗？”
“嗯，我就问问她邀请你没有。你去不去？”
“我没兴趣。”
“那我也不去了，听说除了她新认识的两个女同学，其他人都是公子和小姐。我去了尴尬。”
“嗯，你还是多练习我交给你的拳法吧。”
“我正好有问题问你。”
content_en:
"Light? What light?"
The middle-aged man was slightly startled, and when he looked down, he discovered that there was indeed a faint light coming from his left trouser pocket. He reached out and took it out, and a talisman appeared in his hand.
At this moment, the complex lines on the talisman's seal automatically emitted light, and the light flowed like a dream.
The middle-aged man turned the talisman over, and the words "Exorcist Talisman" suddenly came into view!
"This...this is not..."
The middle-aged man was stunned. Isn't this a talisman sold by a young man wearing sunglasses? Why is it in his pocket? Could it be that the kid stuffed it in while he wasn't paying attention? And what's going on with this light?
Could it be that...there is really evil in my family?
The middle-aged man became more and more astonished as he thought about it. Then he walked around the house holding the talisman. As he walked, the light of the talisman was sometimes strong and sometimes weak. The strongest place was where he placed the bronze sword.
When he turned around the whole room, the light of the talisman was completely revealed.
"Ah Hao, what's going on? Why do I suddenly feel that the air around me has become much clearer, and my head is not so heavy."
The middle-aged man looked at the exorcism talisman in his hand and murmured: "Aying, I don't know why, but I have a feeling that my Zhou family may be in trouble."
"Really?"
The man wanted to say something else, but the phone suddenly came to his mind. It was his assistant.
"What happened?"
"Mr. Zhou, good news. Our group's stock has rebounded tremendously. In addition, the secretary of the Wang family in Kyoto called and plans to invest in our Haotian Group. The stock market movement should be caused by them."
"What? What did you say!"
"I said that the Wang family of Kyoto will buy shares in our group and I will ask you to go to Kyoto tomorrow."
"Hahahaha, OK! OK!"
The middle-aged man laughed. This was the first time he laughed in the past two months.
…
Zhang Yifeng returned to the dormitory and had a comfortable sleep. Early in the morning, he got up and went out to practice boxing. When the cultivation level cannot be improved, the improvement of physical strength is also particularly important. If the earth is really not suitable for cultivation, he can also become a body cultivator and break through ten thousand ways in one body.
After practicing for two hours, Zhang Yifeng went running again. He was practicing kamikaze footwork.
Time passed, and Zhang Yifeng was about to go for lunch when a strange phone call came in.
"Who?" Zhang Yifeng said coldly.
He Yajiao's voice came from the phone: "It's me, He Yajiao. My parents have gone back. I plan to invite Zhang Xiaotian and the others to dinner tonight. I ask you again, will you go?"
"Not interested."
Zhang Yifeng simply said three words and then hung up the phone, without giving any face to the newly promoted school.
"Zhang Yifeng, you bastard!"
On the other end of the phone, He Ya was so angry that she bared her teeth and claws. If she hadn't regarded Zhang Yifeng as a friend, she wouldn't have called her Zhang Yifeng. She really didn't understand good people!
Zhang Yifeng had just hung up the phone when the phone rang again. When he lowered his head, he saw that it was Zhao Long.
"Zhao Long, what's the matter?"
Zhao Long's slightly tired voice came: "I want to ask you about boxing skills. Also, did He Yajiao invite you to dinner?"
"Why, did she ask you to go to dinner too?"
"Well, I'll just ask her if she invited you. Will you go?"
"I'm not interested."
"Then I won't go either. I heard that except for the two new female classmates she met, the others are young men and young ladies. It's embarrassing for me to go."
"Well, you'd better practice more of the boxing techniques I give you."
"I just have a question for you."
